entities.name: Johann Sebastian Bach
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: German composer (1685-1750) whose mastery of counterpoint, harmony, and musical form produced works — the Brandenburg Concertos, Well-Tempered Clavier, Mass in B Minor — that represent the pinnacle of Baroque music and remain foundational to Western musical tradition.
